strings.title: Checkers
strings.choose: Select a piece, then its destination.
strings.waitingHint: Plan your next jump while your friend plays.
strings.continue: Keep jumping with the same piece.
strings.retry: No response yet. Try your move again.
strings.instructions: Men move and jump diagonally forward. Kings move and jump in both directions, one square or one jump at a time. Captures are compulsory; if there is another jump, use the same piece. Choose any capture branch. Reaching the last row crowns your piece and ends the turn. Win when the other side cannot move. Three repeated positions or 40 turns each without a capture or a man moving draw the game.
strings.spectatorHelp: Friends are playing. You can flip the board and watch every move.
